fixed.summary: The fantasy, cartoon and scifi packs key their per-slot sounds by the slots the engine's TSX components declare (`Button.plate`, `Button.plate.primary`) instead of og-ui part names (`Button.base`), so a primary button plays its confirm sound and plate buttons their hover. Cartoon's sounds for `Button.base.danger`, `Radio.card` and `Tabs.tab`, slots no TSX component declares, are gone; those controls play the pack-wide sounds.
